text:
alex_tech: Quick handoff — EU dedicated capacity next-week readiness. Ping owners for checklist.

priya_pm: Thanks, quick status: procurement ETA for A100s from vendor is Wed 2026-04-08 (ETA confirmed by Lydia). Reservation ID: RES-EU-8791. Do we have rack slots reserved?

dan_infra: Rack slots 4-6 reserved in FRA2, power circuit confirmed. Need PDUs from logistics; ETA Fri noon.

maria_ops: Can we get a smoke test plan? I'll own canary traffic and SLA tests. Also need firewall rules from networking (egress to monitoring endpoint).

alex_tech: Dan, any firmware image requirements? runtime team needs nvlink enabled and 470.x driver.

dan_infra: NVLink enabled, driver we plan: 470.182.03. Boot scripts on repo: infra/shells/eu-boot-2026.sh

priya_pm: Owners: procurement @lydia, infra @dan_infra, ops @maria_ops, runtime @alex_tech. Milestone: hardware in-rack by 2026-04-09, canary by 2026-04-12, GA toggles 2026-04-19.

infra-bot: Reminder: Reservation RES-EU-8791 will auto-release in 72h if not acknowledged.

maria_ops: Action: I'll create canary playbook. What capacity target for canary? suggestion: 5% of expected peak = 20 rps.

alex_tech: 20 rps sounds right. Also request 10k token/hour load for perf baseline. Add endpoint test: /v1/generate with model:redwood-eu-1

dan_infra: Quick config snippet for rack mapping:
```
rack-4:
  nodes: [eu-ded-4a, eu-ded-4b]
  circuits: [circuit-07, circuit-08]
```

priya_pm: Blocker: networking needs to approve egress to monitoringhost.redwood.internal — @netops can someone triage?

maria_ops: pinged netops in thread #networking, they asked for IP ranges. I'll paste them.

alex_tech: Also please run a canary with quantized model variant and full-precision for perf delta.

dan_infra: FYI fuse-ks kernel not compatible; runtime will deploy kernel patch on firstboot. @alex_tech can you add kernel patch to preboot steps?

alex_tech: Doing it now. I'll update infra/shells/eu-boot-2026.sh with the patch link and add CI job.

priya_pm: Everyone, please ack by EOD today if you can hit milestone dates.

maria_ops: ack

dan_infra: ack

alex_tech: ack

infra-bot: Audit log: thread acknowledged by 3 participants.
